dataset.source: existing local Binance Spot OHLCV CSV and cached feature arrays; offline only
dataset.folds: existing 180d train / 90d validation / five 90d test windows, no tuning on test

execution.entry: signal on closed candle; next candle open; same existing backtester and gap veto
execution.exit: v1 2*ATR stop and 1R/2R/3R partial targets; stop-first ambiguity convention
execution.allocation: fixed 1000 USD per single-symbol account, 6 daily entries, 30m cooldown
execution.baseline: unchanged technical-v1 signals with existing quality>=7 and Volume_Ratio>=1.5 gate; paper_proxy profile
execution.portfolio_scope: independent symbol/timeframe replays, not an executable shared portfolio

shared_candidate_risk.participation: signal candle Volume_Ratio>=1.5 using previous 20-bar average

A_trend_pullback.regime: same-TF SMA20>SMA50 for LONG or < for SHORT, ADX>=25
A_trend_pullback.trigger: prior close at/below prior EMA12 and signal close above EMA12 for LONG; reverse for SHORT
A_trend_pullback.risk_location: abs(signal close - EMA12)<=1 ATR; no other indicator vote

B_breakout_participation.regime: same-TF SMA20>SMA50 for LONG or < for SHORT
B_breakout_participation.trigger: signal close strictly beyond prior 20 closed-bar high for LONG or low for SHORT
B_breakout_participation.risk_location: breakout overshoot <=1 ATR; no ADX/RSI/MACD vote

C_4h_regime_1h_pullback.regime: latest 4h candle fully closed by 1h signal close: SMA20>SMA50 and ADX>=25 for LONG; reverse for SHORT
C_4h_regime_1h_pullback.trigger: 1h prior-close / EMA12 re-entry as in A

forward_excursion.entry: next open, after signal close; separate all eligible signals from portfolio fills
forward_excursion.first_touch: initial SL vs TP1; same-bar touches labelled AMBIGUOUS_INTRABAR
forward_excursion.mfe_mae: full 24-bar high/low excursions after signal, diagnostic only, not entry features

pass_criteria_frozen.base: sum of independent-series net USD >0, pooled PF>=1.10, pooled expectancy>0, and improves baseline on same series
pass_criteria_frozen.double: sum of independent-series net USD >=0 and pooled PF>=1.00
pass_criteria_frozen.folds: at least 3 of 5 calendar test windows positive when descriptive series PnL is summed
pass_criteria_frozen.symbols: at least half eligible series positive base; removing best symbol leaves positive aggregate net
pass_criteria_frozen.directions: LONG and SHORT each have >=30 executed trades and nonnegative aggregate net base
pass_criteria_frozen.drawdown: median series max DD at base <= same-series v1 paper_proxy median DD
pass_criteria_frozen.parameter_plateau: adjacent 0.75 and 1.25 ATR chase caps must both retain nonnegative aggregate base net and PF>=1
pass_criteria_frozen.selection: at most one candidate; if none meets every requirement, NO CANDIDATE PASSES
pass_criteria_frozen.limitations: exploratory historical test windows have been viewed; passing is not independent final proof; new untouched prospective period required

future_untouched_period: 2026-10-27 UTC onward, only after candidate selection, no changes to running v1; proposed not downloaded/tested here

prospective_entry_timing_sanity_check.definition: features calculated only from saved closed signal candles; no future inputs
